question: Does the positional channel add predictive value when the original C2_B bag coefficient and intercept are frozen as a logit offset?
selection_disclosure: Adaptive follow-up selected after reviewing the positional-text pilot and zero-fit diagnostic; not outcome-blind. The scored temporal windows overlap and are not untouched holdouts.

model.fixed_offset: z0 = saved BAG_LR.intercept_[0] + fit_or_score_base @ BAG_LR.coef_[0], calculated directly in float64 logit space
model.learned_parameters: gamma only, initialized to all-zero, no new intercept
model.acceptance: optimizer success; finite loss, gradient, coefficients; final loss <= zero-gamma loss + 1e-8; no retries
model.empty_or_blank_position: zero positional block; prediction exactly follows fixed bag or missing-stream fallback

arms.SHUFFLED: saved deterministic seed-42 within-document shuffled positional matrix
arms.missing_route: exactly the saved C1_B HGB probability for missing/blank stream rows; threshold >= 0.50

source_boundaries.fit_labels: only rows in each frozen origin fit prefix enter its gamma objective
source_boundaries.query_labels: not read until all four gamma receipts and both prediction bundles are durable and independently verified

gate.interpretation: Diagnostic mechanism evidence only; FAIL ends positional fits; PASS is review-only and does not qualify a champion or authorize upload.

limitations: Bag offsets are in-sample predictions, so this is sequential additive fitting, not cross-fitted residual training.
The follow-up was selected adaptively after earlier evidence; it is not outcome-blind.
The E67 and E75 windows overlap; two origins do not establish generalization.
Passing ESS/clipping or optimizer convergence does not prove a predictive mechanism.
